design.decision: Re-read and rebid a slightly stronger hand.
design.opponent: Hidden until raised cards show up in play.
design.rationale: seed-raise (+12.4 at rare) is the strongest measured enabler and commons need honest enablers; a one-rank version is a near-duplicate kept on purpose to test whether the shape scales down to common.
design.draftText: Opening: Raise every card your team holds by one rank

critic.concerns: Amount-only near-duplicate of seed-raise, labelled as such; raises with no choice, so the decision is only in rebidding.

history.note: draft-common: also proposed as cb-raise-one, cc-raise-one.
